units.source_text: 可是，她又同岛村一起进了客栈，说了声“请安歇吧”，就无影无踪了。

en.t: But she went into the inn again with Shimamura, said, “Please rest now,” and then vanished without a trace.

units.source_text: 不大一会儿，她酌了两杯满满的冷酒，端到他的房间里来，用兴奋的语气说：

en.t: Before long, she poured two brimming cups of cold sake, carried them into his room, and said in an excited voice:
